purpose: Teach: マヤ/デビッド/アンドリュー/トマス/ザック/ゲール/キティ/マンセー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマヤ文明の絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho—your dad's apparently going to read you a picture book about the Maya.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle curiosity in the voice, like she's delighted to share something she learned. Unhurried pace. Slight lift at the end—inviting his response.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとデビッド・カッパーフィールドのマジック観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my dad and I watched David Copperfield do magic tricks.
lines.style: Bright, direct excitement. Words tumble out slightly faster than normal. Genuine joy—not performing for effect, just genuinely eager to share. Slight breathiness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアンドリュー・ロイド・ウェバーのミュージカルを観られるそうよ
lines.en: Sho—your dad says he's going to take you to see an Andrew Lloyd Webber musical.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing tone. Slightly slower pace. The warmth of someone genuinely impressed by what someone else is doing. Soft trailing emphasis on the last phrase.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと機関車トーマス、つまりトマスのおもちゃで遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I played with my dad using Thomas the Tank Engine toys.
lines.style: Quick, unburdened delivery. Small bright energy. Matter-of-fact happiness—no self-consciousness about childlike play. Words land lightly, one after another.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ザック・エフロンの映画を観に行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho—your dad mentioned taking you to see a Zack Efron movie.
lines.style: Soft, indulgent tone. Almost gently amused—not mocking, but noticing the sweetness of it. Measured pace. The voice of someone who finds this detail charming and worth savoring.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとスコットランドのゲール語、つまりゲール民謡聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I learned Korean fan chants—what they call 'Mansae'—with my dad.
lines.style: Quick, energized delivery with a note of pride. The words come out a bit faster, almost proud of the specific knowledge. Slight lift on the unfamiliar word, showing he's pleased to say it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハローキティのグッズを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho—your dad gave you a Hello Kitty gift.
lines.style: Genuinely tender. Slower pace. A small, knowing smile underneath the words—delighted by the specificity and sweetness of the gesture. Warm exhale before the last phrase.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと韓国の応援、つまりマンセーの掛け声を覚えたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I learned to do a Korean cheer with my dad.
lines.style: Satisfied, warm close. Soft energy without losing brightness. The contentment of simple moments. Voice settles slightly—not trailing off, but landing gently on the memory itself.
